goal: AI observability and budgeting in backend/services/ and backend/routers/
summary: Implemented comprehensive AI observability, token tracking, cost modeling, zero-PII telemetry logging, and user/classroom budget caps with capacity limit 429 responses and deterministic fallbacks across backend/services/ and backend/routers/. Fully verified with 7/7 passing tests in tests/v5/test_v5_t069.py and confirmed OpenAPI snapshot parity.

invariants_verified.zero_pii_telemetry: Strict invariant enforced: telemetry logs and database records never store raw prompts, user names, emails, phone numbers, CCCD/CMND numbers, credit cards, or API keys. Telemetry records strictly store cryptographic SHA-256 prompt digests, character counts, and token estimates.
invariants_verified.token_usage_and_latency: Accurate calculation and tracking of prompt tokens, completion tokens, total tokens, and execution latency in milliseconds for every AI operation.
invariants_verified.model_cost_estimation: Dynamic cost estimation model supporting Clara Gemini (gemini-3.8-flash-tiered: $0.10/1M prompt, $0.40/1M completion) and DeepSeek (deepseek-v4-flash: $0.14/1M prompt, $0.28/1M completion) recorded in USD.
invariants_verified.citation_validity_telemetry: Records valid vs dropped/hallucinated citation counts and calculates real-time citation validity rate per request and aggregate window.
invariants_verified.budget_caps_user_and_classroom: Enforces daily token and cost ceilings at both user and classroom levels, resolving custom overrides from ai_budget_caps and defaulting to system guardrails (ai_daily_token_budget_ceiling=500,000, ai_daily_cost_circuit_breaker_usd=$5.00).
invariants_verified.negative_abuse_capacity_response: When daily token or cost budget is exhausted, strict requests receive HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with standard error envelope (code='AI_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED'), explicit Retry-After header, and reset_at/retry_after_seconds details.
invariants_verified.deterministic_fallback_support: When fallback is allowed, exhausted budgets degrade gracefully to deterministic evidence-only answer synthesis without LLM calls, attaching an epistemic disclaimer notice.
invariants_verified.observability_dashboard_api: Staff/Admin endpoints provide system-wide aggregate metrics (total requests, p95 latency, total cost, breakdown by model and operation) and budget cap management.

ai_tutor.guardrail: enforce_budget_guardrail before inference, record_ai_telemetry on completion

ai_qa.guardrail: enforce_budget_guardrail before inference, record_ai_telemetry on completion

history_tutor_ask.guardrail: enforce_budget_guardrail with strict_budget flag and deterministic fallback on budget exhaustion
